notes: THE SHOW/HIDE CONTROL FOR INACTIVE INSTRUMENTS WAS ONE-WAY. Revealing closed EMIs removed the control itself, leaving no way back to the collapsed view until the page was reloaded. The cause: the count of hidden rows was only incremented while they were being hidden, so once revealed the count was zero and the footnote row was not rendered at all. Inactive rows are now counted whether or not they are currently shown, and the label reflects the state: '2 closed or not-yet-started EMIs hidden — show' becomes '2 closed or not-yet-started EMIs shown — hide again'. Verified as a full round trip: collapsed, expanded, collapsed again, with the control present at every step. Applies to both the EMI and investment footnotes. Regression confirms the Projection-to-Dashboard and Decisions-to-chain gaps both remain zero. No page errors.
